title: Don’t wait until the end of your trip to do this tour!
text: Jordan was enthusiastic and engaging as he explained the history of the places we visited. Very informative. My only regret is that we didn’t do this tour earlier in our stay in Barcelona as there where areas he showed us that I would have liked to go back to if we had the time. Highly recommend!!
author: Catherine_P

title: Highly recommend
text: Danny was a great guide. Loved the tour!
author: cassidyh301

title: 100% recommended, ask for Mariah!!
text: Super recommended experience, the tour and the stories and explanations were very interesting. I learned a lot about my own city. The best part without a doubt was the guide, Mariah, who was charming and fun. With her words she conveys love for history, for the city, and for humanity. Thank you so much Mariah, It was a pleasure!!
author: rosariopm1978

title: Mariah was a fun and...
text: Mariah was a fun and engaging tour guide giving a glimpse into Barcelona darker side. The walk was easy and we learned so much that has piqued our imagination and curiosity. Thanks Mariah!
author: wz9x9xpbt7

title: Ghost tour Barcelona
text: We really enjoyed the tour with Mariah! Especially my 15-year-old daughter. Mariah was very knowledgeable and showed us hidden places that we otherwise would not have discovered!
